Definition: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
BiblicalUsage: 1) (plural); 1a) rulers, judges; 1b) divine ones; 1c) angels; 1d) gods; 2) (plural intensive-singular meaning); 2a) god, goddess; 2b) godlike one; 2c) works or special possessions of God; 2d) the (true) God; 2e) God
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
